hero.headline: See the position before you calculate the move.
hero.support: A practical language for reading chess through constrained possibility, reachable states, pressure, boundaries, closure, defects, and repair.

sections.heading: The board is a possibility space
sections.body: A position is not only a list of pieces. It is a structured set of reachable states shaped by legal movement, pressure, protection, access, time, and consequence.

sections.heading: Pressure changes what is reachable
sections.body: Threats and constraints matter because they contract or redirect the opponent's admissible future states.

sections.heading: Good moves preserve continuation
sections.body: A locally attractive action is only useful if the resulting position retains the invariants and options required for the next phase.

sections.heading: Closure is earned
sections.body: Winning material, gaining space, or creating an attack becomes meaningful when the advantage can be stabilized, promoted, or converted.

sections.heading: A public on-ramp
sections.body: Chess makes Boundary First reasoning visible in a bounded world where rules, state, consequence, and counterfactuals can be inspected directly.

built: Worked explanatory grammar and teaching examples
proof.claimBoundary: The framework is offered for teaching, analysis, and falsification; it does not claim superiority to established chess instruction without comparative evidence.
